title: Open-web midterm and final exams without LLM communication
summary: Students complete a midterm and final while allowed to read material on the internet but prohibited from communicating. LLM use was not explicitly allowed, creating a read-only open-web policy intended to exclude conversational AI assistance.

sources.title: My Learnings from Allowing Large Language Models in Introductory Computer Science Classes
